title: Real-Time Closed-Loop Machine Learning Ionic Activity Balancing in Recirculating Hydroponic Systems
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Ion depletion imbalance in closed-loop NFT hydroponics causes nutrient toxicities and ionic antagonism. We deployed an array of solid-state Ion-Selective Electrodes (ISE for $K^+$, $Ca^{2+}$, $NO_3^-$, $NH_4^+$) interfaced with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network. The AI system predicted plant ion uptake rates with 98.2% accuracy, maintaining target nutrient ratios for 45 days without full drain-and-refill cycles.
key_findings: LSTM neural network reduced fertigation solution discharge by 94%, achieving near-zero effluent waste.
Target $Ca:K$ ratio was maintained at 1:1.4 within a tight error margin of ±0.05 mM.
Water use efficiency (WUE) increased from 32 L/kg FW to 18 L/kg FW.
